_comment: The platform's rules over the mothership's own logs. health-manager emit writes one JSON line per health event, identifier tappaas-health (ADR-041 D4); cmdb sweep writes one per difference, identifier cmdb-sweep (ADR-040 D15). A critical root cause is not a rule here: health-manager emit mails it itself, one notice from when it becomes a root cause to when it stops being one, for whatever reason. A warning, a performance root or a sweep finding waits for the daily digest; a silenced event (acknowledged, in maintenance) is recorded and not mailed. These are event rules: an alert over a log line resolves when its window moves on. Which events leave the site is this file's choice, as ADR-039 D1 intends: edit the match. The security scan writes one line per scan, identifier tappaas-security: new open critical/high CVEs are mailed at once (cve-new-critical), other changes wait for the digest; a module's CVE risk level rising to high or critical is a health event of its own (cve-level-up).

rules.name: health-daily-digest
rules.title: HealthDailyDigest
rules.headline: Daily digest
rules.summary: In the last 24 hours a condition became a warning root cause, the security scan saw CVE changes that need no mail of their own (a new analysed or carried item, a level going down), or the discovery sweep found drift, something unmanaged, missing, or differing from config/. One mail a day while this fires; nothing when a day passes quietly. health-manager digest writes the mail, an ALERT when it has something new and a STATUS when not; the template below goes out only when it cannot.

mail.subject: {state}: daily digest could not be built
mail.body:
== Daily digest
health-manager could not write today's digest, so this mail does not say what is new.

health-manager list shows every condition that is not ok; cmdb sweep --last the last sweep's differences.
In Grafana (Explore, Loki): {query}

rules.name: cve-new-critical
rules.title: CveNewCritical
rules.headline: New critical or high CVEs nobody has analysed
rules.summary: The security scan (after a sweep, or the daily rescan) found critical or high CVEs that are new since the last scan and that no VEX statement analyses. One mail per scan, listing them. A module whose security condition is acknowledged or in maintenance is left out.

mail.subject: {state}: {label.count} new open critical/high CVE(s) in {label.modules}

rules.name: cve-level-up
rules.title: CveLevelUp
rules.headline: A module's CVE risk level rose to high or critical
rules.summary: A module's or a node's CVE risk level rose to high or critical. A level going down, and every other change, waits for the daily digest.

mail.subject: {state}: CVE risk of {label.name} is now {label.level}
